```{r multi-model-fit, include=FALSE}
model_formulas <- list(
  A = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx + tlr:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx + tlr:Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  ),
  B_crp = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + crp:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + crp:Rx
  ),
  B_tlr = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + tlr:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + tlr:Rx
  ),
  B_tmb = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp + tlr + tmb_braf + tmb_braf:Rx
  ),
  C_crp = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + crp:Rx
  ),
  C_tlr = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tlr:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tlr:Rx
  ),
  C_tmb = list(
    os = Surv(OSwk, Death) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tmb_braf:Rx,
    pfs = Surv(PFSwk, Progression) ~ Age + sex + Rx + tmb_braf:Rx
  )
)

model_labels_short <- c(
  "A" = "Model A",
  "B_crp" = "Model B-CRP",
  "B_tlr" = "Model B-TLR",
  "B_tmb" = "Model B-TMB",
  "C_crp" = "Model C-CRP",
  "C_tlr" = "Model C-TLR",
  "C_tmb" = "Model C-TMB"
)

distributions <- c("gamma", "weibullph")
model_types <- names(model_formulas)

multi_models <- list()
for (dist in distributions) {
  multi_models[[dist]] <- list()
  for (mt in model_types) {
    multi_models[[dist]][[mt]] <- list()
    for (outcome in c("os", "pfs")) {
      formula <- model_formulas[[mt]][[outcome]]
      tryCatch({
        multi_models[[dist]][[mt]][[outcome]] <- flexsurvreg(
          formula = formula,
          data = data_complete,
          dist = dist
        )
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(paste("Failed to fit", mt, outcome, dist, ":", e$message))
      })
    }
  }
}
```

```{r generate-predictions, include=FALSE}
predict_population_avg <- function(model, newdata, times) {
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

  n_patients <- nrow(newdata)
  surv_matrix <- matrix(NA, nrow = n_patients, ncol = length(times))

  for (i in 1:n_patients) {
    tryCatch({
      pred <- summary(model, newdata = newdata[i, , drop = FALSE],
                      t = times, type = "survival", ci = FALSE)
      surv_matrix[i, ] <- pred[[1]]$est
    }, error = function(e) {
      surv_matrix[i, ] <- NA
    })
  }

  colMeans(surv_matrix, na.rm = TRUE)
}

time_points <- seq(0, time_horizon, by = 1)

strategies_df <- data.frame(
  biomarker = c("crp", "tlr", "tmb_braf"),
  prevalence = c(
    mean(data_complete$crp, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(data_complete$tlr, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(data_complete$tmb_braf, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

multi_predictions <- list()

for (dist in distributions) {
  multi_predictions[[dist]] <- list()

  for (mt in model_types) {
    multi_predictions[[dist]][[mt]] <- list()

    control_data <- data_complete
    control_data$Rx <- 0

    os_model <- multi_models[[dist]][[mt]]$os
    pfs_model <- multi_models[[dist]][[mt]]$pfs

    if (!is.null(os_model) && !is.null(pfs_model)) {
      control_os <- predict_population_avg(os_model, control_data, time_points)
      control_pfs <- predict_population_avg(pfs_model, control_data, time_points)

      multi_predictions[[dist]][[mt]]$control <- list(
        os = control_os,
        pfs = control_pfs
      )
    }

    for (i in 1:nrow(strategies_df)) {
      biomarker <- strategies_df$biomarker[i]
      prevalence <- strategies_df$prevalence[i]

      pos_data <- data_complete[data_complete[[biomarker]] == 1, ]
      neg_data <- data_complete[data_complete[[biomarker]] == 0, ]

      if (nrow(pos_data) > 0 && nrow(neg_data) > 0) {
        pos_data$Rx <- 1
        neg_data$Rx <- 0

        if (!is.null(os_model) && !is.null(pfs_model)) {
          pos_os <- predict_population_avg(os_model, pos_data, time_points)
          pos_pfs <- predict_population_avg(pfs_model, pos_data, time_points)
          neg_os <- predict_population_avg(os_model, neg_data, time_points)
          neg_pfs <- predict_population_avg(pfs_model, neg_data, time_points)

          weighted_os <- prevalence * pos_os + (1 - prevalence) * neg_os
          weighted_pfs <- prevalence * pos_pfs + (1 - prevalence) * neg_pfs

          weighted_name <- paste0(biomarker, "_weighted")
          multi_predictions[[dist]][[mt]][[weighted_name]] <- list(
            os = weighted_os,
            pfs = weighted_pfs
          )
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r create-pfs-plots, include=FALSE}
create_pfs_plot <- function(biomarker, model_types_subset, color_scheme,
                            strategy_prefix, factor_levels) {
  strategy_data <- data.frame()

  for (dist in c("gamma", "weibullph")) {
    ctrl_pred <- multi_predictions[[dist]][["A"]]$control
    if (!is.null(ctrl_pred)) {
      strategy_data <- rbind(strategy_data, data.frame(
        time = time_points,
        pfs = ctrl_pred$pfs,
        strategy = "Control",
        distribution = dist
      ))
    }
  }

  weighted_name <- paste0(biomarker, "_weighted")
  for (model_type in model_types_subset) {
    for (dist in c("gamma", "weibullph")) {
      pred <- multi_predictions[[dist]][[model_type]][[weighted_name]]
      if (!is.null(pred)) {
        strategy_data <- rbind(strategy_data, data.frame(
          time = time_points,
          pfs = pred$pfs,
          strategy = paste(strategy_prefix, "-", model_labels_short[model_type]),
          distribution = dist
        ))
      }
    }
  }

  strategy_data$strategy <- factor(strategy_data$strategy, levels = factor_levels)

  ggplot(strategy_data, aes(x = time, y = pfs,
                             color = strategy, linetype = distribution)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_scheme, name = "Strategy") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c("gamma" = "solid", "weibullph" = "dashed"),
                          labels = c("Gamma", "Weibull PH"),
                          name = "Distribution") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, max(time_points), by = 104),
                       labels = function(x) x / 52) +
    labs(x = "Time (years)", y = "Progression-Free Survival",
         title = paste(strategy_prefix, "Strategy")) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom",
          legend.box = "vertical",
          legend.margin = margin(t = 0, b = 0),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(order = 1, nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 2))
}

p_crp_pfs <- create_pfs_plot(
  biomarker = "crp",
  model_types_subset = c("A", "B_crp", "C_crp"),
  color_scheme = c(
    "Control" = "gray50",
    "CRP - Model A" = "#E69F00",
    "CRP - Model B-CRP" = "#56B4E9",
    "CRP - Model C-CRP" = "#0072B2"
  ),
  strategy_prefix = "CRP",
  factor_levels = c("Control", "CRP - Model A", "CRP - Model B-CRP", "CRP - Model C-CRP")
)

p_tlr_pfs <- create_pfs_plot(
  biomarker = "tlr",
  model_types_subset = c("A", "B_tlr", "C_tlr"),
  color_scheme = c(
    "Control" = "gray50",
    "TLR - Model A" = "#E69F00",
    "TLR - Model B-TLR" = "#009E73",
    "TLR - Model C-TLR" = "#D55E00"
  ),
  strategy_prefix = "TLR",
  factor_levels = c("Control", "TLR - Model A", "TLR - Model B-TLR", "TLR - Model C-TLR")
)

p_tmb_pfs <- create_pfs_plot(
  biomarker = "tmb_braf",
  model_types_subset = c("A", "B_tmb", "C_tmb"),
  color_scheme = c(
    "Control" = "gray50",
    "TMB - Model A" = "#E69F00",
    "TMB - Model B-TMB" = "#F0E442",
    "TMB - Model C-TMB" = "#CC79A7"

)
```
